summary: Tested Upload Supervision Document feature end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 tests passed. Frontend: Upload form, Analysis flow, DocUploadReport page all working correctly. One critical UI bug found: 'Imported Documents' section in staff portfolio is hidden when staff has 0 signed-off meetings.

ui_bugs.issue: Imported Documents section (imported-docs-list, import-supervision-prompt) is nested inside the `stats.total_meetings > 0` else branch (line 429-606). When staff has 0 signed-off meetings, the empty state replaces the entire right panel including the Imported Documents section, so uploaded documents are never visible in the portfolio.

action_items: Fix StaffPortfolio.js: Move the 'Imported Documents' section outside of the stats.total_meetings === 0 conditional. The section (lines 524-601) should render independently of whether there are signed-off meetings. Suggested fix: show the Imported Documents section below the empty state div (after line 428), or restructure the right panel so it always renders with the Imported Documents section regardless of total_meetings count.
critical_code_review_comments: StaffPortfolio.js: Imported Documents section (canViewUploads + docUploads) is inside the `stats.total_meetings > 0` JSX branch — this means it never shows for staff with no signed-off meetings, which is the exact case when importing docs is most valuable (e.g., new staff).
Minor HTML hydration warning: <span> inside <option> in UploadSupervision.js staff dropdown (does not affect functionality)

success_rate.frontend: 85% - upload/report/sidebar/staff-restriction all pass; portfolio Imported Docs section blocked by conditional

seed_data_creation: Created and deleted a test docx upload during backend tests. Existing upload 6a46b912a09c5dcbd7140086 preserved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All doc upload features work except StaffPortfolio imported docs section. Fix needed in StaffPortfolio.js around line 421-429: the Imported Documents right-panel section must be accessible even when total_meetings = 0. After fix, test /portfolio/6a3e5728bb3b2159b3c93f63 as manager to verify imported-docs-list shows with the existing upload (ID 6a46b912a09c5dcbd7140086, Staff Member, 5 CQC + 2 Care Cert).
rca_of_issue: Root cause: StaffPortfolio.js renders a ternary at line 421 — `stats.total_meetings === 0 ? <empty-state> : <full-two-column-panel>`. The right column containing Imported Documents is only in the `<full-two-column-panel>` branch. Fix: Extract the Imported Documents section from the right column and render it unconditionally (or append it after the empty state). The docUploads fetch (line 287-293) is correct and returns data — the bug is purely in the render tree.
